notes.title: June 2025 Update
notes.content:
Dear Skyfarmers,

I hope you are doing well! I wanted to give you a quick update on the game's development:

[b][h3]First Gameplay Trailer![/h3][/b]
Skyfarm got its first gameplay trailer! Check it out here:

[previewyoutube=xOCi1NLqVrE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
[h1][/h1]

[b][h3]Demo in Progress[/h3][/b]
We’re hard at work on a playable demo! Including:

- A completely redesigned UI
- New music, sounds, plants, and more!
- Tons of new features and things to do on your roof-top farm.

It’s not quite ready yet, but I’ll keep you posted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187129/1f304c14b7979693a1c68f2f9860251f670236af.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]See You at Gamescom?[/h3][/b]
Skyfarm is headed to Gamescom this August as part of the SwissGames delegation! If you're around, come say hi!  It'd be amazing to meet some of you in person.

Plant concepts and world-building sketches:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187129/9234bf82e7fa03f4a83923a5972409ea55b04354.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]Join the Community[/h3][/b]
Want to chat with fellow Skyfarmers, peek behind the scenes (a lot of cat pictures), or help us playtest? Come hang out on our [url=https://discord.gg/F2EaSJgGfK]Discord[/url]! We’d love to have you there.

That’s all for now, thanks for being part of this journey!


Until next time,
Lena / Plaid Games
